import subprocess, time, pathlib, os, requests
p=subprocess.Popen(['node','server.js'],cwd='/app',stdout=open('/tmp/gearvault.log','w'),stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=os.environ.copy())
pathlib.Path('/tmp/gearvault.pid').write_text(str(p.pid))
time.sleep(3)
print('pid',p.pid,'poll',p.poll())
print(pathlib.Path('/tmp/gearvault.log').read_text())
if p.poll() is None:
 r=requests.get('http://localhost:3000/api/health',headers={'X-Demo-User':'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa'},timeout=5); print(r.status_code,r.text)
 r=requests.get('http://localhost:3000/api/overview',headers={'X-Demo-User':'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa'},timeout=5); print(r.status_code, len(r.json().get('units',[])))
